evals.expected_output: An annotated gh command plan that creates AbsaOSS/aquasec-scan-results as public from the cps-repository-template, adds the Apache-2.0 LICENSE, grants jdoe admin, sets CODEOWNERS with jdoe, clones the ABSA label taxonomy from the template, applies the Core Branches ruleset, sets auto-delete branches, and shows that the absa-group project link cannot be applied to an OSS repo (cross-org) — shown for confirmation before execution.
